prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Create a professional full-body activewear catalog photograph of the adult athlete Michaela in reference 1, preserving her exact face, freckles, highlighted curly bun, small gold hoops and athletic proportions.
Dress her in the actual Black GOAL Athletics garments pictured in references 2-5. References 2-3 are the WB0025 fitted ankle-length leggings, high waistband, smooth matte performance jersey, plain front, curved waistband seams, flat ankle hems and one small white/red GA logo centered on the back waistband. No other branding or added details on the leggings. References 4-5 are the actual Black TEMPO WT0093 sports bra: broad shoulder straps, scoop neckline, proper solid racerback, bound edges and flat elastic hem. Bra front plain. Bra back has a small cream GA logo centered above the hem, matching reference 5. Match the garments' actual shapes and seam layouts faithfully. Include ordinary unbranded white trainers.
Studio setting: neutral gray seamless backdrop and floor, soft natural product lighting and contact shadows. Realistic professional sportswear photography, natural skin texture, no retouching of body shape, no props or lettering. Portrait 1024x1536, one photograph, full head and both shoes visible, clothing clearly shown.
Front view, hips and shoulders square to camera. Warm confident smile, one hand resting lightly at her hip and the other relaxed at her side, a little weight on one leg. Both garment fronts are plain black, with no visible logos in this view.

Create an alternate professional activewear catalog photo of the same adult athlete in image 1 wearing exactly the same black racerback sports bra, black ankle-length leggings and white trainers. Preserve Michaela's identity, highlighted curly bun, freckles, build and outfit. Turn her body 30 degrees to a front-left quarter view, with a natural small walking step and cheerful laugh looking just off camera, one hand casually near her hair. Images 2 and 3 confirm the actual product cuts: plain wide-strap WT0093 bra front and plain WB0025 legging front with high curved waistband. Keep both fronts unbranded. Same gray studio, lighting, full-body portrait 1024x1536. One image, no text or added accessories.

Create an alternate full-body rear catalog view of the same adult athlete Michaela from image 1, wearing the same black GOAL Athletics training outfit and white trainers. Use images 2 and 3 as exact product back references. Bra: broad-strap black solid racerback with a small cream GA monogram centered on its lower back panel above the flat hem. Leggings: black WB0025 high waistband and ankle-length cut, with a separate small white/red GA monogram centered on the back waistband exactly like image 3. Preserve the actual garment seams and logo shapes, colors and placements. No extra logos or wording. Michaela stands naturally with one foot slightly back, arms relaxed, head gently turned toward camera with a friendly smile. Preserve her face and highlighted curly bun. Same gray studio, restrained professional product photography, 1024x1536 portrait with head and shoes fully visible.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target: this existing finished GOAL Athletics clothing catalog photograph. Change ONLY the small existing cream GA monogram centered low on the back of the black racerback sports bra: make its G white and its A red, matching the white/red GA monogram already on the leggings waistband. Preserve the bra monogram's exact silhouette, size, position, perspective, and flat printed texture. Keep the leggings and their existing monogram completely unchanged. Preserve everything else in the photo unchanged: the same adult Michaela, face, expression, hair, pose, body proportions, actual broad-strap WT0093 racerback bra construction, WB0025 leggings, shoes, fabric, seams, lighting, gray studio background, framing, and 1024x1536 composition. No other edits, additions, rescaling, or text.

ghost_front_update.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium three-dimensional INVISIBLE-MANNEQUIN FRONT product photograph of the Black WB0025 high-rise leggings. Image 1 is the exact garment reference for cut, high wide waistband, curved waistband seam, unprinted front, smooth nylon/spandex knit and flat ankle hems. Image 2 is a fit reference only: use the leggings' natural fitted shape on the wearer, without including the person or any other garment. Present the leggings ALONE, filled out exactly as if being worn by an invisible athletic model: rounded waistband and hip volume, softly shaped thighs, knees and calves, realistic fabric tension and a few subtle natural knee creases. Relaxed standing stance with one knee gently relaxed and a slight offset between the two legs. Waistband opening has a believable elliptical rim and natural interior depth. Keep the garment's actual seams and proportions, matte performance-knit texture and true black color. Clean front view with slight photographic depth, no added design details, logos, pockets, stripes, drawstrings or ribbed cuffs. No visible person, skin, mannequin parts, torso, feet, shoes or bra. Float the complete pair just above a soft diffuse oval shadow on a light neutral-gray seamless studio background, using soft side lighting to show fabric volume clearly. Portrait 1024x1536. Entire waistband and both hems visible, product fills about 85 percent of image height, generous margins and consistent premium catalog framing. One photograph, no text or watermark.
